disabledRules.description: Requests to remove rules. Never honoured for a mandatory rule; listed so the refusal is visible.

failOnSeverity.description: Findings at or above this severity fail the policy. Lower is stricter.

requireCompleteCoverage.description: Required checks that do not complete fail the policy with exit 2.

providers.description: Providers the repository asks to use; only those the adopted settings define are usable.

RepoConfigEnvelope.description: sentinel-repoconfig/draft-1 — version-controlled scan intent. It requests; it cannot grant, weaken or approve.

RuleFamilyId.description: A stable rule family: `sentinel.<area>.<name>` for original rules, `<vendor>.<area>.<name>` otherwise.

Severity.description: The severity a rule assigns. Ordered: info < low < medium < high < critical.

RuleCapability.description: A property a stage must establish before the rule can be checked. A profile that lacks one leaves the check unsupported; nothing weaker runs under the rule's identity.

SuppressionRequest.description: A repository's request to suppress a finding. Recorded and refused: approval is an owner disposition.

ScopeId.description: A scope reference such as `<sourceId>:<relativePath>` or a surface ID. Untrusted protocol data: bounded, free of control characters, never resolved as a filesystem path.

BoundedText.description: Untrusted text supplied by a producer (a scanner message, a rationale). Always escaped when rendered.

Id.description: A ledger identifier. Opaque, bounded and free of path separators and whitespace.
